thread:
maria: quick RFC follow-up: dequant fusion orchestration across int4/int8/fp8 kernels — how do we want runtime to pick fused vs non-fused attn path? cc @jin @akshay

akshay: short: prefer fused when quant format matches kernel and seq_len <= kernel_max_seq. fallback to non-fused if KV cache mismatch or memory pressure.

jin: question: how do we detect 'KV cache mismatch' cheaply? checking dtype + kv stride? we need to avoid per-request memcpy.

maria: right — thought: tag requests with 'quant_profile' at ingress. ingress does cheap check: model_dtype + requested_quant. then router picks node with matching kernel variant.

lorna: concern: network routing churn if we pin too strictly. maybe allow same-node mixed-exec: dequant fuse at kernel level if tensors are contiguous and align to 16B? fallback if not.

samir: ops note: also consider memory amplification for fp8->fp16 dequantized cache. if per-token KV doubles memory, scheduling will OOM on high batch. need admission control.

akshay: agree. propose policy enum: STRICT_PIN, FLEX_MIX, FORCE_NONFUSED. default FLEX_MIX. actor picks based on load and mem.

jin: implementation note: kernel interface should expose `supports_fused_dequant(request_meta)` and fast path checks. example: ```cpp
bool supports_fused_dequant(int dtype, int seq, void* ptr);
``` keep it tiny.

maria: docs + logs: we should surface why we chose fused vs fallback in traces — add `dequant_choice` tag to spans.

lorna: :thumbsup: also add a perf counter: fused_tokens vs nonfused_tokens so Optimize can recommend quant profiles.

buildbot: buildkite:ci triggered pipeline 4721 for branch quant-orch. tests: int8/fp8/auto-fallback ✅

samir: follow-up Q: do we want auto-requantization between stages? e.g., attn in int4 then MLP requantize to int8.

jin: prefer localized requant: only if sum of ops saves memory or improves throughput. risky for accuracy — add eval gating.

maria: action items: 1) akshay draft policy enums + admission control pseudo-code. 2) jin add kernel interface PR. 3) lorna add metrics and tracing tags. 4) samir add mem-sim tests. target end-of-week.

akshay: ack, will start on sketch.

lorna: I'll add dashboards for fused/nonfused tokens.

maria: thanks. one more: add small note in the RFC about cross-temp storage for kv so fused path doesn't require reshape copies.
